description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'EmploymentContractAPI' class, which provides REST API endpoints for retrieving and updating an employee's employment contract details within a Human Resource Management (HRM) system. It handles operations such as fetching employment contract data, updating contract dates, and managing contract attachments.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class providing endpoints to retrieve and update employee employment contracts, including handling contract dates and attachments.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the employment contract details for a specified employee, identified by employee number. Returns a model object containing the contract data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET operation parameters, specifically validating employee number accessibility.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an employee's employment contract, including dates and attachments, based on request payload.

methods.name: updateEmploymentContract
methods.description: Updates the start and end dates of the employment contract for a given employee.

methods.name: updateContractAttachment
methods.description: Manages the attachment associated with the employment contract, including adding, replacing, or deleting the attachment.

methods.name: setAttachmentAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes of a contract attachment based on uploaded base64 content.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating employment contract details and attachments.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete operation is not implemented; throws an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Delete validation rules are not implemented; throws an exception.
